title: TICTeC Presents: Digital Democracy Edinburgh (11 & 12 March 2027)
content:
Digital Democracy Edinburgh will take place on 11 & 12 March 2027 in Edinburgh, Scotland. 

Save the date to join us for two days of exploring how digital tools can help make democratic systems more effective, inclusive and participatory.

How can we practically use technology to improve democratic decision-making and resilience?

This is the core question of this event, which we will answer by bringing together a global audience of practitioners and experts from civic tech, democratic innovation, and local and national governments.

Through the conference, we will explore how high-quality, deliberative, participation can be enhanced through digital technology, in democracies around the world. We will explore the use of technology to make collective decisions, solve shared problems, and govern ourselves effectively.

This means bringing together expertise and cutting-edge findings to support groups contributing to difficult decisions around the world – including findings about the uses of AI technologies which the public can trust.
